description: This file provides polyfill functions for the mbstring extension in PHP, defining various string manipulation functions that delegate to the Symfony Mbstring class. It ensures compatibility if the mbstring extension is absent, enabling multibyte string support.

classes.name: p
classes.description: Namespace alias for Symfony\Polyfill\Mbstring, used internally within the functions.

methods.name: mb_convert_encoding
methods.description: Converts string between character encodings.

methods.name: mb_decode_mimeheader
methods.description: Decodes MIME header strings.

methods.name: mb_encode_mimeheader
methods.description: Encodes MIME header strings.

methods.name: mb_decode_numericentity
methods.description: Decodes numeric character references.

methods.name: mb_encode_numericentity
methods.description: Encodes numeric character references.

methods.name: mb_convert_case
methods.description: Converts the case of a string.

methods.name: mb_internal_encoding
methods.description: Gets or sets the internal character encoding.

methods.name: mb_language
methods.description: Sets the current language.

methods.name: mb_list_encodings
methods.description: Returns all supported encodings.

methods.name: mb_encoding_aliases
methods.description: Returns encoding aliases.

methods.name: mb_check_encoding
methods.description: Checks if encoding conversion or detection is possible.

methods.name: mb_detect_encoding
methods.description: Detects the character encoding of a string.

methods.name: mb_detect_order
methods.description: Gets or sets the character encoding detection order.

methods.name: mb_parse_str
methods.description: Parses URL-encoded strings into variables.

methods.name: mb_strripos

methods.name: mb_strrpos
methods.description: Finds position of last occurrence in a string.

methods.description: Finds first occurrence of a string.

methods.description: Sets or gets the HTTP output character encoding.

methods.name: mb_substr_count
methods.description: Counts the number of substring occurrences.

methods.name: mb_output_handler
methods.description: Handler for output buffering with multibyte conversions.

methods.name: mb_convert_variables
